Từ Dụ Từ Dụ or Từ Dũ (20 June 1810 – 12 May 1902), born Phạm Thị Hằng (范氏姮), was the wife of Thiệu Trị and mother of Tự Đức. Hằng was a daughter of Phạm Đăng Hưng. She was granted the title Empress Dowager Từ Dụ after Tự Đức ascended the throne. Tự Đức died in 1883. Three regents, Nguyễn Văn Tường, Tôn Thất Thuyết and Trần Tiễn Thành, declared Dục Đức, the eldest adoptive-son of Tự Đức, as the new emperor. Three days later, they deposed Dục Đức and enthroned Hiệp Hòa. Từ Dụ was elevated to the position of one of the "Tam Cung" (三宮) together with Trang Ý and Học phi. Từ Dụ played a significant role in the dethronement of Hiệp Hòa, whom was a pro-French emperor, and enthroned Kiến Phúc. In 1885, she was granted the title Grand Empress Dowager Từ Dụ . Từ Dụ Từ Dụ or Từ Dũ (20 June 1810 – 12 May 1902), born Phạm Thị Hằng (范氏姮), was the wife of Thiệu Trị and mother of Tự Đức. Hằng was a daughter of Phạm Đăng Hưng. She was granted the title Empress Dowager Từ Dụ after Tự Đức ascended the throne. Tự Đức died in 1883. Three regents, Nguyễn Văn Tường, Tôn Thất Thuyết and Trần Tiễn Thành, declared Dục Đức, the eldest adoptive-son of Tự Đức, as the new emperor. Three days later, they deposed Dục Đức and enthroned Hiệp Hòa. Từ Dụ was elevated to the position of one of the "Tam Cung" (三宮) together with Trang Ý and Học phi. Từ Dụ played a significant role in the dethronement of Hiệp Hòa, whom was a pro-French emperor, and enthroned Kiến Phúc. In 1885, she was granted the title Grand Empress Dowager Từ Dụ . Tôn Thất Thuyết decided to launch the Cần Vương movement against French colonists. " Tam Cung" fled to Tomb of Tự Đức together with Empero...
